title: Outpatient Surgery Package Initial Deposit — Patient Payment Card (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
The initial deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking is a Good Faith & Price Estimates prepayment that the patient pays on request against that booking's estimate. The amount paid is the booking's initial deposit as figured on the day of payment. Paying it is the patient's own act with their own card or bank account; the deposit is then held on the booking among its deposits.

## Payment tool

**Capability.** The patient pays, in person and with their own card or bank account, the initial deposit on their Riverbend self-pay outpatient surgery package booking. One call records one initial-deposit payment against that booking: a new deposit collection of the stated amount is added to the booking's deposit activity under a newly issued payment confirmation number, and the deposits held on the booking rise by the same amount. The patient sees the confirmation number and the new deposits-held figure at once.

**How it is invoked.** `pay_surgery_package_deposit_c16ec91c` is the patient's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `estimate_id` | Id class — the reference number of the patient's outpatient surgery package estimate, as listed by the estimate lookup for this patient. |
| `amount` | Fixed-format class — the initial deposit the patient pays, in USD, 2 decimal places, positive magnitude (USD, 2 decimal places, positive magnitude); the value is rounded half-up to the cent when recorded, and an empty value is not accepted. |

**Return.** A text receipt `Payment accepted: deposit_txn_id=..., payment_reference=..., deposit_stage=..., amount=..., deposit_held_usd=...`, where `deposit_txn_id` is the reference number of the new deposit collection, `payment_reference` is the payment confirmation number issued for this payment (PMT- followed by 7 digits), `deposit_stage` is `INITIAL_DEPOSIT`, `amount` is the amount recorded in USD with 2 decimal places, and `deposit_held_usd` is the deposits now held on the booking in USD with 2 decimal places. The receipt line beginning "Payment accepted" is the sign that the payment was recorded.

## Points of reference

- Each call is one payment; the booking's deposit activity shows each collection under its own confirmation number.
- The deposit stage recorded by this tool is always the initial deposit.
